about: Yuval H. Marcus is a top-rated attorney who practices law in White Plains, New York. Yuval Marcus focuses on Intellectual Property Litigation issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Mergers & Acquisitions and Intellectual Property.

Yuval Marcus received Super Lawyers designation for 2011 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 1994. Before practicing law, he attended law school at Yeshiva University Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law and graduated in 1994.
